HomePage.title: Local Time Machine
HomePage.tagline: See what your home looked like millions of years ago.
HomePage.intro: Pick a place. Travel back through deep time and see the ground beneath it drift across the planet — ocean, tropics, ice, and back again.
HomePage.placesSub: A validation preview built from open plate-reconstruction models. Every result carries its own honesty box.
HomePage.waitlistSub: We're building the full version — any spot on Earth, every epoch. Leave your email and we'll tell you when it's live.
HomePage.waitlistSuccess: You're on the list. Thanks for the curiosity.
HomePage.waitlistInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
HomePage.waitlistError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Place.notFormedTitle: The ground here hadn't been born yet
Place.notFormedBody: At this point in deep time, the crust beneath {name} did not exist. It would form later.
Place.accuracyCoastline: Land vs. ocean is judged against reconstructed modern coastlines, so shallow inland seas can read as "land."
Place.frameFixedNote: You are standing still at today's latitude/longitude (blue dot) while the continents move through this point (in the model's reference frame).
Place.satelliteHonesty: Satellite-style artistic rendering on open reconstruction data. Coastlines are real (muller2022, full source resolution) and mountain ranges rise where the model's plates collide (reconstructed subduction zones and orogenic belts); their exact shapes, and all rivers, are artistic texture — no satellite photographed the deep past, and positions carry ±100 km+ uncertainty.
Place.beyondData: Beyond data resolution — texture is artistic
Place.dragHint: Drag to pan · scroll or +/− to zoom
